data.description: System settings for the application. This struct is used to load and save settings from a configuration file.

auto_start.description: Auto start the application on system login

listen_addr_ipv4.description: listen ipv4 address for the server to bind to

listen_addr_ipv6.description: listen ipv6 address for the server to bind to

local_signaling_token.description:
Local signaling server token, auto-generated and persisted.
Used by the local desk server to authenticate with the co-located signaling server.

manager_api_token.description: API Token for connecting to manager's signaling server

manager_url.description: Remote manager server url for connecting to an enterprise manager

port.description: port number for the server to bind to

signaling_token.description: Token for authenticating with the remote signaling server

signaling_url.description: Remote signaling server url for connecting to a standalone signaling server
